<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.0"></script>
<style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --primary: #6366f1;
            --primary-dark: #4f46e5;
            --secondary: #10b981;
            --danger: #ef4444;
            --warning: #f59e0b;
            --bg-dark: #0f0f23;
            --bg-card: #1a1a2e;
            --bg-input: #16213e;
            --text-primary: #ffffff;
            --text-secondary: #94a3b8;
            --border: #334155;
            --gradient-1: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
            --gradient-2: linear-gradient(135deg, #f093fb 0%, #f5576c 100%);
            --gradient-3: linear-gradient(135deg, #4facfe 0%, #00f2fe 100%);
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Pretendard', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.6;
            min-height: 100vh;
        }

        /* Header */
        .header {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(99,102,241,0.15) 0%, transparent 100%);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding: 20px 0;
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            z-index: 100;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
        }

        .header-content {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0 20px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .logo {
            font-size: 28px;
            font-weight: 800;
            background: var(--gradient-1);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .company-info {
            text-align: right;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .company-info strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        /* Hero Section */
        .hero {
            padding: 80px 20px;
            text-align: center;
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center top, rgba(99,102,241,0.2) 0%, transparent 60%);
        }

        .hero h1 {
            font-size: 48px;
            font-weight: 800;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            background: var(--gradient-1);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .hero p {
            font-size: 20px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            max-width: 600px;
            margin: 0 auto 40px;
        }

        .hero-stats {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 60px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .hero-stat {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .hero-stat-value {
            font-size: 42px;
            font-weight: 800;
            background: var(--gradient-3);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .hero-stat-label {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 5px;
        }

        /* Main Container */
        .container {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0 20px;
        }

        /* Section */
        .section {
            margin-bottom: 80px;
        }

        .section-header {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }

        .section-number {
            display: inline-block;
            width: 50px;
            height: 50px;
            line-height: 50px;
            background: var(--gradient-1);
            border-radius: 50%;
            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .section-title {
            font-size: 36px;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        .section-desc {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 18px;
        }

        /* Cards Grid */
        .cards-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(400px, 1fr));
            gap: 30px;
        }

        .card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 30px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            transition: transform 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
        }

        .card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
        }

        .card-title {
            font-size: 22px;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            padding-bottom: 15px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        /* Full Width Card */
        .card-full {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
        }

        /* Input Groups */
        .input-group {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .input-group label {
            display: block;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .input-group input, .input-group select {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 14px 18px;
            background: var(--bg-input);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 12px;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 16px;
            transition: border-color 0.3s;
        }

        .input-group input:focus, .input-group select:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: var(--primary);
        }

        .input-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));
            gap: 15px;
        }

        /* Buttons */
        .btn {
            padding: 14px 28px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            background: var(--gradient-1);
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            transform: scale(1.02);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(99,102,241,0.3);
        }

        .btn-secondary {
            background: var(--bg-input);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .btn-danger {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ef4444 0%, #dc2626 100%);
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-success {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #10b981 0%, #059669 100%);
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-group {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        /* Results Display */
        .result-box {
            background: var(--bg-input);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 25px;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .result-row {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 12px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .result-row:last-child {
            border-bottom: none;
        }

        .result-label {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .result-value {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 18px;
        }

        .result-value.positive {
            color: var(--secondary);
        }

        .result-value.negative {
            color: var(--danger);
        }

        .result-value.warning {
            color: var(--warning);
        }

        /* Chart Container */
        .chart-container {
            position: relative;
            height: 350px;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .chart-container-large {
            height: 450px;
        }

        /* Leverage Slider */
        .leverage-display {
            text-align: center;
            margin: 20px 0;
        }

        .leverage-value {
            font-size: 64px;
            font-weight: 800;
            background: var(--gradient-2);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .leverage-slider {
            width: 100%;
            height: 8px;
            -webkit-appearance: none;
            background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--secondary) 0%, var(--warning) 50%, var(--danger) 100%);
            border-radius: 4px;
            outline: none;
            margin: 20px 0;
        }

        .leverage-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
            -webkit-appearance: none;
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 50%;
            cursor: pointer;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
        }

        .leverage-marks {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        /* Risk Meter */
        .risk-meter {
            height: 12px;
            background: var(--bg-input);
            border-radius: 6px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin: 15px 0;
        }

        .risk-meter-fill {
            height: 100%;
            transition: width 0.5s, background 0.5s;
            border-radius: 6px;
        }

        .risk-level {
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-top: 10px;
        }

        /* Scenario Table */
        .scenario-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .scenario-table th,
        .scenario-table td {
            padding: 15px;
            text-align: center;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .scenario-table th {
            background: var(--bg-input);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .scenario-table tr:hover {
            background: rgba(99,102,241,0.1);
        }

        /* Progress Steps */
        .progress-steps {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            margin-bottom: 40px;
            position: relative;
        }

        .progress-steps::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 20px;
            left: 10%;
            right: 10%;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--border);
        }

        .step {
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .step-circle {
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            line-height: 40px;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 2px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 50%;
            margin: 0 auto 10px;
            font-weight: 700;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .step.active .step-circle {
            background: var(--gradient-1);
            border-color: var(--primary);
        }

        .step-label {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .step.active .step-label {
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        /* Funding Rate Display */
        .funding-display {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 20px;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .funding-item {
            background: var(--bg-input);
            padding: 20px;
            border-radius: 16px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .funding-rate {
            font-size: 32px;
            font-weight: 800;
        }

        .funding-label {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 5px;
        }

        /* Position Display */
        .position-visual {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 30px;
            padding: 40px;
            background: var(--bg-input);
            border-radius: 16px;
            margin: 20px 0;
        }

        .position-bar {
            flex: 1;
            height: 60px;
            background: var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .position-entry {
            position: absolute;
            width: 4px;
            height: 100%;
            background: white;
            z-index: 3;
        }

        .position-liquidation {
            position: absolute;
            width: 4px;
            height: 100%;
            background: var(--danger);
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .position-current {
            position: absolute;
            width: 4px;
            height: 100%;
            background: var(--primary);
            z-index: 4;
            transition: left 0.3s;
        }

        .position-zone-profit {
            position: absolute;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(16,185,129,0.3);
        }

        .position-zone-loss {
            position: absolute;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(239,68,68,0.3);
        }

        .position-labels {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            margin-top: 10px;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        /* Comparison Cards */
        .comparison-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .comparison-card {
            background: var(--bg-input);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 25px;
            text-align: center;
            border: 2px solid transparent;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .comparison-card.recommended {
            border-color: var(--secondary);
            background: rgba(16,185,129,0.1);
        }

        .comparison-leverage {
            font-size: 36px;
            font-weight: 800;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        .comparison-detail {
            margin: 10px 0;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .comparison-detail span {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* SNS Links */
        .sns-section {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 40px;
            margin: 60px 0;
            text-align: center;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .sns-title {
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
        }

        .sns-links {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 15px;
        }

        .sns-link {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 14px 28px;
            background: var(--bg-input);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 12px;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 600;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .sns-link:hover {
            background: var(--primary);
            border-color: var(--primary);
            transform: translateY(-3px);
        }

        .sns-link span {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 400;
            margin-left: 8px;
        }

        /* Footer */
        .footer {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding: 50px 20px;
            margin-top: 80px;
        }

        .footer-content {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));
            gap: 40px;
        }

        .footer-section h4 {
            font-size: 18px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            color: var(--primary);
        }

        .footer-section p {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 14px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .footer-bottom {
            text-align: center;
            padding-top: 40px;
            margin-top: 40px;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        /* Animations */
        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
            50% { transform: scale(1.05); }
        }

        .pulse {
            animation: pulse 2s infinite;
        }

        /* Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .hero h1 { font-size: 32px; }
            .hero-stats { gap: 30px; }
            .cards-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .comparison-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .funding-display { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        /* Tabs */
        .tabs {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 25px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding-bottom: 15px;
        }

        .tab {
            padding: 10px 20px;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            border-radius: 8px;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .tab.active {
            background: var(--primary);
            color: white;
        }

        .tab:hover:not(.active) {
            background: var(--bg-input);
        }

        .tab-content {
            display: none;
        }

        .tab-content.active {
            display: block;
        }

        /* Warning Box */
        .warning-box {
            background: rgba(245,158,11,0.1);
            border: 1px solid var(--warning);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 20px;
            margin: 20px 0;
        }

        .warning-box-title {
            color: var(--warning);
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .warning-box p {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        /* Danger Box */
        .danger-box {
            background: rgba(239,68,68,0.1);
            border: 1px solid var(--danger);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 20px;
            margin: 20px 0;
        }

        .danger-box-title {
            color: var(--danger);
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        /* Success Box */
        .success-box {
            background: rgba(16,185,129,0.1);
            border: 1px solid var(--secondary);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 20px;
            margin: 20px 0;
        }

        .success-box-title {
            color: var(--secondary);
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        /* Live Indicator */
        .live-indicator {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 6px 14px;
            background: rgba(239,68,68,0.2);
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .live-dot {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            background: var(--danger);
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: pulse 1s infinite;
        }
    </style>

<script>
        // 색상 정의
        const colors = {
            primary: '#6366f1',
            secondary: '#10b981',
            danger: '#ef4444',
            warning: '#f59e0b',
            purple: '#8b5cf6',
            cyan: '#06b6d4',
            pink: '#ec4899'
        };

        // 숫자 포맷팅
        function formatNumber(num, decimals = 2) {
            return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
                minimumFractionDigits: decimals,
                maximumFractionDigits: decimals
            }).format(num);
        }

        function formatCurrency(num, decimals = 2) {
            return '$' + formatNumber(num, decimals);
        }

        // ===== Section 1: 청산가격 계산기 =====
        let liquidationChart;

        function updateLeverage(value) {
            document.getElementById('leverageDisplay').textContent = value + 'x';
            
            // 리스크 미터 업데이트
            const riskPercent = (value / 125) * 100;
            const riskMeter = document.getElementById('riskMeter');
            const riskLevel = document.getElementById('riskLevel');
            
            riskMeter.style.width = riskPercent + '%';
            
            if (value <= 5) {
                riskMeter.style.background = colors.secondary;
                riskLevel.style.color = colors.secondary;
                riskLevel.textContent = '낮은 위험';
            } else if (value <= 20) {
                riskMeter.style.background = colors.warning;
                riskLevel.style.color = colors.warning;
                riskLevel.textContent = '중간 위험';
            } else if (value <= 50) {
                riskMeter.style.background = colors.danger;
                riskLevel.style.color = colors.danger;
                riskLevel.textContent = '높은 위험';
            } else {
                riskMeter.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg, #ef4444, #dc2626)';
                riskLevel.style.color = '#dc2626';
                riskLevel.textContent = '매우 높은 위험';
            }
            
            calculateLiquidation();
        }

        function calculateLiquidation() {
            const entryPrice = parseFloat(document.getElementById('entryPrice').value);
            const positionSize = parseFloat(document.getElementById('positionSize').value);
            const leverage = parseInt(document.getElementById('leverageSlider').value);
            const direction = document.getElementById('positionDirection').value;
            
            const margin = positionSize / leverage;
            const maintenanceMargin = 0.005; // 0.5% 유지증거금
            
            let liquidationPrice;
            if (direction === 'long') {
                liquidationPrice = entryPrice * (1 - (1 / leverage) + maintenanceMargin);
            } else {
                liquidationPrice = entryPrice * (1 + (1 / leverage) - maintenanceMargin);
            }
            
            const distance = ((liquidationPrice - entryPrice) / entryPrice) * 100;
            
            // 결과 업데이트
            document.getElementById('resultEntry').textContent = formatCurrency(entryPrice, 0);
            document.getElementById('resultLiquidation').textContent = formatCurrency(liquidationPrice, 0);
            document.getElementById('resultDistance').textContent = (distance >= 0 ? '+' : '') + formatNumber(distance, 1) + '%';
            document.getElementById('resultMargin').textContent = formatCurrency(margin, 2);
            document.getElementById('resultMaxLoss').textContent = '-' + formatCurrency(margin, 2);
            
            // 경고 박스
            const warningBox = document.getElementById('warningBox');
            const warningText = document.getElementById('warningText');
            
            if (leverage >= 50) {
                warningBox.style.display = 'block';
                warningText.textContent = `${leverage}x 레버리지에서는 ${formatNumber(Math.abs(distance), 1)}%만 움직여도 청산됩니다. 극도의 주의가 필요합니다.`;
            } else if (leverage >= 20) {
                warningBox.style.display = 'block';
                warningText.textContent = `높은 레버리지(${leverage}x)는 작은 가격 변동에도 청산될 수 있습니다.`;
            } else {
                warningBox.style.display = 'none';
            }
            
            // 차트 업데이트
            updateLiquidationChart(entryPrice, direction);
        }

        function updateLiquidationChart(entryPrice, direction) {
            const leverages = [1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 20, 25, 50, 75, 100, 125];
            const maintenanceMargin = 0.005;
            
            const liquidationPrices = leverages.map(lev => {
                if (direction === 'long') {
                    return entryPrice * (1 - (1 / lev) + maintenanceMargin);
                } else {
                    return entryPrice * (1 + (1 / lev) - maintenanceMargin);
                }
            });
            
            const distances = liquidationPrices.map(liq => 
                Math.abs(((liq - entryPrice) / entryPrice) * 100)
            );
            
            if (liquidationChart) {
                liquidationChart.destroy();
            }
            
            const ctx = document.getElementById('liquidationChart').getContext('2d');
            liquidationChart = new Chart(ctx, {
                type: 'bar',
                data: {
                    labels: leverages.map(l => l + 'x'),
                    datasets: [
                        {
                            label: '청산가격',
                            data: liquidationPrices,
                            backgroundColor: leverages.map(l => {
                                if (l <= 5) return colors.secondary + '80';
                                if (l <= 20) return colors.warning + '80';
                                return colors.danger + '80';
                            }),
                            borderColor: leverages.map(l => {
                                if (l <= 5) return colors.secondary;
                                if (l <= 20) return colors.warning;
                                return colors.danger;
                            }),
                            borderWidth: 2,
                            borderRadius: 8,
                            yAxisID: 'y'
                        },
                        {
                            label: '청산까지 거리 (%)',
                            data: distances,
                            type: 'line',
                            borderColor: colors.purple,
                            backgroundColor: colors.purple + '20',
                            borderWidth: 3,
                            fill: true,
                            tension: 0.4,
                            yAxisID: 'y1'
                        }
                    ]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    interaction: {
                        mode: 'index',
                        intersect: false
                    },
                    plugins: {
                        legend: {
                            labels: { color: '#94a3b8' }
                        },
                        tooltip: {
                            backgroundColor: '#1a1a2e',
                            titleColor: '#fff',
                            bodyColor: '#94a3b8',
                            borderColor: '#334155',
                            borderWidth: 1,
                            callbacks: {
                                label: function(context) {
                                    if (context.datasetIndex === 0) {
                                        return '청산가격: ' + formatCurrency(context.raw, 0);
                                    }
                                    return '거리: ' + formatNumber(context.raw, 2) + '%';
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    scales: {
                        x: {
                            grid: { color: '#334155' },
                            ticks: { color: '#94a3b8' }
                        },
                        y: {
                            position: 'left',
                            grid: { color: '#334155' },
                            ticks: { 
                                color: '#94a3b8',
                                callback: value => '$' + (value/1000).toFixed(0) + 'K'
                            },
                            title: {
                                display: true,
                                text: '청산가격',
                                color: '#94a3b8'
                            }
                        },
                        y1: {
                            position: 'right',
                            grid: { display: false },
                            ticks: { 
                                color: colors.purple,
                                callback: value => value.toFixed(0) + '%'
                            },
                            title: {
                                display: true,
                                text: '청산까지 거리',
                                color: colors.purple
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        // ===== Section 2: 손익 시뮬레이터 =====
        let pnlChart;

        function updateCurrentPrice(changePercent) {
            const entry = parseFloat(document.getElementById('pnlEntry').value);
            const currentPrice = entry * (1 + changePercent / 100);
            
            document.getElementById('pnlCurrentDisplay').textContent = formatCurrency(currentPrice, 0);
            document.getElementById('pnlChangePercent').textContent = 
                (changePercent >= 0 ? '+' : '') + changePercent + '%';
            document.getElementById('pnlChangePercent').style.color = 
                changePercent >= 0 ? colors.secondary : colors.danger;
            
            calculatePnL();
        }

        function calculatePnL() {
            const entry = parseFloat(document.getElementById('pnlEntry').value);
            const investment = parseFloat(document.getElementById('pnlInvestment').value);
            const leverage = parseInt(document.getElementById('pnlLeverage').value);
            const direction = document.getElementById('pnlDirection').value;
            const changePercent = parseInt(document.getElementById('pnlCurrentSlider').value);
            
            const currentPrice = entry * (1 + changePercent / 100);
            const positionValue = investment * leverage;
            
            let pnlPercent;
            if (direction === 'long') {
                pnlPercent = ((currentPrice - entry) / entry) * 100 * leverage;
            } else {
                pnlPercent = ((entry - currentPrice) / entry) * 100 * leverage;
            }
            
            const unrealizedPnL = investment * (pnlPercent / 100);
            
            // 청산가격 계산
            const maintenanceMargin = 0.005;
            let liquidationPrice;
            if (direction === 'long') {
                liquidationPrice = entry * (1 - (1 / leverage) + maintenanceMargin);
            } else {
                liquidationPrice = entry * (1 + (1 / leverage) - maintenanceMargin);
            }
            
            const liqDistance = ((liquidationPrice - currentPrice) / currentPrice) * 100;
            
            // 결과 업데이트
            document.getElementById('pnlPositionValue').textContent = formatCurrency(positionValue, 0);
            
            const unrealizedEl = document.getElementById('pnlUnrealized');
            unrealizedEl.textContent = (unrealizedPnL >= 0 ? '+' : '') + formatCurrency(unrealizedPnL, 2);
            unrealizedEl.className = 'result-value ' + (unrealizedPnL >= 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative');
            
            const roeEl = document.getElementById('pnlROE');
            roeEl.textContent = (pnlPercent >= 0 ? '+' : '') + formatNumber(pnlPercent, 1) + '%';
            roeEl.className = 'result-value ' + (pnlPercent >= 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative');
            
            document.getElementById('pnlLiqPrice').textContent = formatCurrency(liquidationPrice, 0);
            document.getElementById('pnlLiqDistance').textContent = formatNumber(liqDistance, 1) + '%';
            
            // 차트 업데이트
            updatePnLChart(entry, investment, leverage, direction);
        }

        function updatePnLChart(entry, investment, leverage, direction) {
            const priceChanges = [-20, -15, -10, -5, -2, 0, 2, 5, 10, 15, 20];
            
            const pnlData = priceChanges.map(change => {
                let pnl;
                if (direction === 'long') {
                    pnl = investment * (change / 100) * leverage;
                } else {
                    pnl = investment * (-change / 100) * leverage;
                }
                return Math.max(pnl, -investment); // 최대 손실은 투자금
            });
            
            const roeData = priceChanges.map(change => {
                let roe;
                if (direction === 'long') {
                    roe = change * leverage;
                } else {
                    roe = -change * leverage;
                }
                return Math.max(roe, -100);
            });
            
            if (pnlChart) {
                pnlChart.destroy();
            }
            
            const ctx = document.getElementById('pnlChart').getContext('2d');
            pnlChart = new Chart(ctx, {
                type: 'bar',
                data: {
                    labels: priceChanges.map(c => (c >= 0 ? '+' : '') + c + '%'),
                    datasets: [

                            borderColor: pnlData.map(v => v >= 0 ? colors.secondary : colors.danger),
                            borderWidth: 2,
                            borderRadius: 8,

                        },
                        {
                            label: 'ROE (%)',
                            data: roeData,
                            type: 'line',
                            borderColor: colors.cyan,
                            backgroundColor: 'transparent',
                            borderWidth: 3,
                            tension: 0.4,
                            pointRadius: 5,
                            pointBackgroundColor: colors.cyan,
                            yAxisID: 'y1'
                        }
                    ]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    interaction: {
                        mode: 'index',
                        intersect: false
                    },
                    plugins: {
                        legend: {
                            labels: { color: '#94a3b8' }
                        },
                        tooltip: {
                            backgroundColor: '#1a1a2e',
                            titleColor: '#fff',
                            bodyColor: '#94a3b8',
                            borderColor: '#334155',
                            borderWidth: 1
                        }
                    },
                    scales: {
                        x: {
                            grid: { color: '#334155' },
                            ticks: { color: '#94a3b8' },
                            title: {
                                display: true,
                                text: '가격 변동률',
                                color: '#94a3b8'
                            }
                        },
                        y: {
                            position: 'left',

        }

        // ===== Section 3: 포지션 사이징 =====
        let positionSizeChart;

        function calculatePositionSize() {
            const capital = parseFloat(document.getElementById('totalCapital').value);
            const riskPercent = parseFloat(document.getElementById('riskPercent').value);
            const entry = parseFloat(document.getElementById('psEntry').value);
            const stopLoss = parseFloat(document.getElementById('psStopLoss').value);
            const leverage = parseInt(document.getElementById('psLeverage').value);
            
            const maxLoss = capital * (riskPercent / 100);
            const stopPercent = ((stopLoss - entry) / entry) * 100;
            
            // 포지션 크기 = 최대손실금액 / (손절폭% / 100)
            const positionSize = maxLoss / (Math.abs(stopPercent) / 100);
            const margin = positionSize / leverage;
            const btcAmount = positionSize / entry;
            
            document.getElementById('psMaxLoss').textContent = '-' + formatCurrency(maxLoss, 0);
            document.getElementById('psStopPercent').textContent = formatNumber(stopPercent, 1) + '%';
            document.getElementById('psRecommended').textContent = formatCurrency(positionSize, 0);
            document.getElementById('psMargin').textContent = formatCurrency(margin, 0);
            document.getElementById('psBtcAmount').textContent = formatNumber(btcAmount, 4) + ' BTC';
            
            updatePositionSizeChart(capital, entry, stopLoss, leverage);
        }

        function updatePositionSizeChart(capital, entry, stopLoss, leverage) {
            const riskLevels = [0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10];
            const stopPercent = Math.abs((stopLoss - entry) / entry);
            
            const positionSizes = riskLevels.map(risk => {
                const maxLoss = capital * (risk / 100);
                return maxLoss / stopPercent;
            });
            
            const margins = positionSizes.map(ps => ps / leverage);
            
            if (positionSizeChart) {
                positionSizeChart.destroy();
            }
            
            const ctx = document.getElementById('positionSizeChart').getContext('2d');
            positionSizeChart = new Chart(ctx, {
                type: 'bar',
                data: {
                    labels: riskLevels.map(r => r + '%'),
                    datasets: [
                        {
                            label: '포지션 크기',
                            data: positionSizes,
                            backgroundColor: riskLevels.map(r => {
                                if (r <= 2) return colors.secondary + '80';
                                if (r <= 5) return colors.warning + '80';
                                return colors.danger + '80';
                            }),
                            borderColor: riskLevels.map(r => {
                                if (r <= 2) return colors.secondary;
                                if (r <= 5) return colors.warning;
                                return colors.danger;
                            }),
                            borderWidth: 2,
                            borderRadius: 8
                        }
                    ]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    plugins: {

                            borderColor: '#334155',

                            callbacks: {
                                label: function(context) {
                                    const idx = context.dataIndex;
                                    return [
                                        '포지션: ' + formatCurrency(positionSizes[idx], 0),
                                        '증거금: ' + formatCurrency(margins[idx], 0),
                                        '최대손실: ' + formatCurrency(capital * riskLevels[idx] / 100, 0)
                                    ];
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    scales: {
                        x: {
                            grid: { color: '#334155' },
                            ticks: { color: '#94a3b8' },
                            title: {
                                display: true,
                                text: '리스크 허용률',
                                color: '#94a3b8'
                            }
                        },
                        y: {
                            grid: { color: '#334155' },
                            ticks: { 
                                color: '#94a3b8',
                                callback: value => '$' + (value/1000).toFixed(0) + 'K'
                            },
                            title: {
                                display: true,
                                text: '포지션 크기 (USDT)',
                                color: '#94a3b8'
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        // ===== Section 4: 리스크/리워드 =====
        let rrChart;

        function calculateRiskReward() {
            const entry = parseFloat(document.getElementById('rrEntry').value);
            const stopLoss = parseFloat(document.getElementById('rrStopLoss').value);
            const takeProfit = parseFloat(document.getElementById('rrTakeProfit').value);
            const investment = parseFloat(document.getElementById('rrInvestment').value);
            const winRate = parseFloat(document.getElementById('rrWinRate').value) / 100;
            
            const riskPercent = Math.abs((stopLoss - entry) / entry);
            const rewardPercent = Math.abs((takeProfit - entry) / entry);
            
            const riskAmount = investment * riskPercent;
            const rewardAmount = investment * rewardPercent;
            
            const rrRatio = rewardPercent / riskPercent;
            const expectedValue = (winRate * rewardAmount) - ((1 - winRate) * riskAmount);
            const breakevenWinRate = 1 / (1 + rrRatio);
            
            document.getElementById('rrRisk').textContent = '-' + formatCurrency(riskAmount, 2);
            document.getElementById('rrReward').textContent = '+' + formatCurrency(rewardAmount, 2);
            document.getElementById('rrRatio').textContent = '1:' + formatNumber(rrRatio, 2);
            
            const evEl = document.getElementById('rrExpectedValue');
            evEl.textContent = (expectedValue >= 0 ? '+' : '') + formatCurrency(expectedValue, 2);
            evEl.className = 'result-value ' + (expectedValue >= 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative');
            
            document.getElementById('rrBreakeven').textContent = formatNumber(breakevenWinRate * 100, 1) + '%';
            
            // 판정
            const verdictEl = document.getElementById('rrVerdict');
            if (expectedValue > 0 && rrRatio >= 2) {
                verdictEl.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="success-box">
                        <div class="success-box-title">우수한 트레이드</div>
                        <p>R:R 비율 ${formatNumber(rrRatio, 1)}과 ${formatNumber(winRate*100, 0)}% 승률에서 기대값이 +${formatCurrency(expectedValue, 2)}입니다. 진입을 고려해볼 만합니다.</p>
                    </div>
                `;
            } else if (expectedValue > 0) {
                verdictEl.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="warning-box">
                        <div class="warning-box-title">괜찮은 트레이드</div>
                        <p>기대값은 양수이나, R:R 비율(${formatNumber(rrRatio, 1)})이 2:1 이상이면 더 좋습니다.</p>
                    </div>
                `;
            } else {
                verdictEl.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="danger-box">
                        <div class="danger-box-title">재고 필요</div>
                        <p>현재 설정으로는 기대값이 음수(${formatCurrency(expectedValue, 2)})입니다. 손절/익절 비율을 조정하세요.</p>
                    </div>
                `;
            }
            
            updateRRChart();
        }

        function updateRRChart() {
            const rrRatios = [0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 4, 5];
            const breakevenRates = rrRatios.map(rr => (1 / (1 + rr)) * 100);
            
            if (rrChart) {
                rrChart.destroy();
            }
            
            const ctx = document.getElementById('rrChart').getContext('2d');
            rrChart = new Chart(ctx, {
                type: 'line',
                data: {
                    labels: rrRatios.map(r => '1:' + r),
                    datasets: [
                        {
                            label: '손익분기 승률',
                            data: breakevenRates,
                            borderColor: colors.primary,
                            backgroundColor: colors.primary + '20',

                        },

                            callbacks: {

                                    return `R:R ${context.label} → 필요 승률: ${formatNumber(context.raw, 1)}%`;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    scales: {
                        x: {
                            grid: { color: '#334155' },
                            ticks: { color: '#94a3b8' },
                            title: {
                                display: true,
                                text: 'Risk:Reward 비율',
                                color: '#94a3b8'
                            }
                        },
                        y: {
                            grid: { color: '#334155' },
                            ticks: { 
                                color: '#94a3b8',
                                callback: value => value + '%'
                            },
                            title: {
                                display: true,
                                text: '손익분기 승률',
                                color: '#94a3b8'
                            },
                            min: 0,
                            max: 100
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        // ===== Section 5: 펀딩비 계산기 =====
        let fundingChart;

        function calculateFunding() {
            const fundingRate = parseFloat(document.getElementById('fundingInput').value);
            const positionSize = parseFloat(document.getElementById('fundingPosition').value);
            const days = parseInt(document.getElementById('fundingDays').value);
            
            const perFunding = positionSize * (fundingRate / 100);
            const daily = perFunding * 3;
            const monthly = daily * 30;
            const total = daily * days;
            const annualAPY = (daily * 365 / positionSize) * 100;
            
            document.getElementById('fundingRate').textContent = 
                (fundingRate >= 0 ? '+' : '') + fundingRate + '%';
            document.getElementById('fundingRate').className = 
                'funding-rate ' + (fundingRate >= 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative');
            
            document.getElementById('fundingAnnual').textContent = formatNumber(annualAPY, 2) + '%';
            
            document.getElementById('fundingPerTime').textContent = 
                (perFunding >= 0 ? '+' : '') + formatCurrency(perFunding, 2);
            document.getElementById('fundingDaily').textContent = 
                (daily >= 0 ? '+' : '') + formatCurrency(daily, 2);
            document.getElementById('fundingMonthly').textContent = 
                (monthly >= 0 ? '+' : '') + formatCurrency(monthly, 2);
            document.getElementById('fundingTotal').textContent = 
                (total >= 0 ? '+' : '') + formatCurrency(total, 2);
            document.getElementById('fundingAPY').textContent = formatNumber(annualAPY, 2) + '%';
            
            updateFundingChart(positionSize);
        }

        function updateFundingChart(positionSize) {
            const fundingRates = [-0.05, -0.03, -0.01, 0, 0.01, 0.02, 0.03, 0.05, 0.1];
            const annualReturns = fundingRates.map(rate => {
                const daily = positionSize * (rate / 100) * 3;
                return (daily * 365 / positionSize) * 100;
            });
            
            if (fundingChart) {
                fundingChart.destroy();
            }
            
            const ctx = document.getElementById('fundingChart').getContext('2d');
            fundingChart = new Chart(ctx, {
                type: 'bar',
                data: {
                    labels: fundingRates.map(r => r + '%'),
                    datasets: [
                        {
                            label: '연간 수익률 (%)',
                            data: annualReturns,
                            backgroundColor: annualReturns.map(v => v >= 0 ? colors.secondary + '80' : colors.danger + '80'),

                            }
                        }

                }
            });
        }

        // ===== Section 6: 레버리지 비교 =====
        let comparisonChart;

        function updateComparison() {
            const investment = parseFloat(document.getElementById('compareInvestment').value);
            const priceChange = parseFloat(document.getElementById('comparePriceChange').value);
            
            const leverages = [1, 3, 5, 10, 20, 50];
            const grid = document.getElementById('comparisonGrid');
            grid.innerHTML = '';
            
            leverages.forEach((lev, idx) => {
                const pnlPercent = priceChange * lev;
                const pnlAmount = investment * (pnlPercent / 100);
                const liquidationDistance = 100 / lev;
                const isRecommended = lev >= 3 && lev <= 10;
                
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = 'comparison-card' + (isRecommended ? ' recommended' : '');
                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="comparison-leverage">${lev}x</div>
                    ${isRecommended ? '<div style="color: var(--secondary); font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 10px;">권장 레버리지</div>' : ''}
                    <div class="comparison-detail">손익: <span style="color: ${pnlAmount >= 0 ? colors.secondary : colors.danger};">${pnlAmount >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${formatCurrency(pnlAmount, 0)}</span></div>
                    <div class="comparison-detail">ROE: <span style="color: ${pnlPercent >= 0 ? colors.secondary : colors.danger};">${pnlPercent >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${pnlPercent}%</span></div>
                    <div class="comparison-detail">청산거리: <span>${formatNumber(liquidationDistance, 1)}%</span></div>
                `;
                grid.appendChild(card);
            });
            
            // 차트 업데이트
            const allLeverages = [1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 20, 25, 50, 75, 100];
            const pnlData = allLeverages.map(lev => {

                return Math.max(pnl, -investment);
            });
            
            if (comparisonChart) {

            const ctx = document.getElementById('comparisonChart').getContext('2d');
            comparisonChart = new Chart(ctx, {
                type: 'line',
                data: {
                    labels: allLeverages.map(l => l + 'x'),
                    datasets: [
                        {

                            data: pnlData,

                                    const lev = allLeverages[context.dataIndex];
                                    return [

                                        `ROE: ${(priceChange * lev >= 0 ? '+' : '') + (priceChange * lev)}%`
                                    ];
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    scales: {

        // 초기화
