<style>
        :root {
            --bg-primary: #0b0e11;
            --bg-secondary: #12161c;
            --bg-tertiary: #1e2329;
            --bg-hover: #2b3139;
            --text-primary: #eaecef;
            --text-secondary: #848e9c;
            --text-muted: #5e6673;
            --accent-gold: #f0b90b;
            --accent-gold-hover: #fcd535;
            --long-green: #0ecb81;
            --long-green-bg: rgba(14, 203, 129, 0.1);
            --short-red: #f6465d;
            --short-red-bg: rgba(246, 70, 93, 0.1);
            --neon-blue: #00d4ff;
            --neon-purple: #b84dff;
            --neon-pink: #ff4d94;
            --border-color: #2b3139;
            --card-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
            --glow-green: 0 0 20px rgba(14, 203, 129, 0.4);
            --glow-red: 0 0 20px rgba(246, 70, 93, 0.4);
            --glow-gold: 0 0 30px rgba(240, 185, 11, 0.3);
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Rajdhani', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif;
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            min-height: 100vh;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }

        /* 스크롤바 커스텀 */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: var(--accent-gold);
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        /* ============================================
           상단 회사 정보 바
           ============================================ */
        .top-info-bar {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 8px 20px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0d1117 0%, #161b22 100%);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .top-info-left {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 20px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .minjine-logo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .minjine-icon {
            font-size: 24px;
            color: var(--accent-gold);
            text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(240, 185, 11, 0.5);
            animation: pulse-glow 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse-glow {
            0%, 100% { text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(240, 185, 11, 0.5); }
            50% { text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(240, 185, 11, 0.8), 0 0 30px rgba(240, 185, 11, 0.4); }
        }

        .minjine-text {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 800;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-gold) 0%, #ffd700 50%, var(--accent-gold) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            letter-spacing: 3px;
        }

        .minjine-sub {
            font-size: 9px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            margin-left: 5px;
        }

        .company-info {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .company-info .divider {
            color: var(--border-color);
        }

        .top-info-right {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .top-sns-links {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .top-sns-links a {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            border-radius: 50%;
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 14px;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            border: 1px solid transparent;
        }

        .top-sns-links a:hover {
            background: var(--accent-gold);
            border-color: var(--accent-gold);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(240, 185, 11, 0.3);
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .top-info-bar {
                padding: 6px 12px;
            }
            
            .company-info {
                display: none;
            }
            
            .minjine-text {
                font-size: 14px;
            }
            
            .minjine-icon {
                font-size: 18px;
            }
            
            .top-sns-links a {
                width: 24px;
                height: 24px;
                font-size: 12px;
            }
        }

        /* ============================================
           하단 푸터 스타일
           ============================================ */
        .main-footer {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0d1117 0%, #161b22 100%);
            border-top: 2px solid var(--accent-gold);
            padding: 30px 20px;
            margin-top: auto;
        }

        .footer-content {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .footer-brand-section {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: 40px;
            padding-bottom: 25px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            margin-bottom: 25px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .footer-minjine-logo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .footer-logo-icon {
            font-size: 40px;
            color: var(--accent-gold);
            text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(240, 185, 11, 0.6);
        }

        .footer-logo-text {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .footer-logo-main {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 28px;
            font-weight: 900;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-gold) 0%, #ffd700 50%, #fff 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            letter-spacing: 4px;
        }

        .footer-logo-sub {
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        .footer-company-details {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.8;
        }

        .footer-company-details p {
            margin: 4px 0;
        }

        .footer-company-details strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        /* SNS 그리드 */
        .footer-sns-section {
            padding-bottom: 25px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            margin-bottom: 25px;
        }

        .footer-section-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-gold);
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .footer-sns-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(140px, 1fr));
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .sns-card {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            padding: 12px 15px;
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            border-radius: 8px;
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            border: 1px solid transparent;
        }

        .sns-card:hover {
            background: var(--bg-hover);
            border-color: var(--accent-gold);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
        }

        .sns-card .sns-icon {
            font-size: 20px;
        }

        .sns-card .sns-name {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .sns-card .sns-id {
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            display: block;
        }

        .sns-card.tiktok:hover { border-color: #ff0050; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(255, 0, 80, 0.2); }
        .sns-card.youtube:hover { border-color: #ff0000; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.2); }
        .sns-card.instagram:hover { border-color: #e4405f; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(228, 64, 95, 0.2); }
        .sns-card.threads:hover { border-color: #ffffff; }
        .sns-card.kakao:hover { border-color: #fee500; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(254, 229, 0, 0.2); }
        .sns-card.tistory:hover { border-color: #eb531f; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(235, 83, 31, 0.2); }
        .sns-card.telegram:hover { border-color: #0088cc; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 136, 204, 0.2); }
        .sns-card.naver:hover { border-color: #03c75a; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(3, 199, 90, 0.2); }

        /* 투자 경고 박스 */
        .footer-disclaimer-section {
            margin-bottom: 25px;
        }

        .disclaimer-box {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(246, 70, 93, 0.1) 0%, rgba(246, 70, 93, 0.05) 100%);
            border: 1px solid var(--short-red);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .disclaimer-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--short-red);
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .disclaimer-content {
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.8;
        }

        .disclaimer-content p {
            margin: 6px 0;
        }

        .disclaimer-content strong {
            color: var(--short-red);
        }

        /* 저작권 */
        .footer-copyright {
            text-align: center;
            padding-top: 20px;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .copyright-logo {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--accent-gold);
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(240, 185, 11, 0.3);
        }

        .copyright-text {
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .copyright-developers {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .main-footer {
                padding: 20px 15px;
                padding-bottom: 90px;
            }
            
            .footer-brand-section {
                flex-direction: column;
                gap: 20px;
            }
            
            .footer-logo-main {
                font-size: 22px;
            }
            
            .footer-logo-icon {
                font-size: 32px;
            }
            
            .footer-sns-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }
            
            .sns-card {
                padding: 10px 12px;
            }
        }

        /* 설명 아이콘 & 툴팁 시스템 */
        .help-icon {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 14px;
            height: 14px;
            background: rgba(240, 185, 11, 0.2);
            border: 1px solid var(--accent-gold);
            border-radius: 50%;
            font-size: 9px;
            color: var(--accent-gold);
            cursor: pointer;
            margin-left: 4px;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .help-icon:hover {
            background: var(--accent-gold);
            color: var(--bg-primary);
            transform: scale(1.1);
        }

        /* 상단 스티키 설명 패널 */
        .explanation-bar {
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1f3a 0%, #2d1f4a 100%);
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent-gold);
            padding: 8px 12px;
            z-index: 1100;
            display: none;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: 10px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(240, 185, 11, 0.3);
        }

        .explanation-bar.show {
            display: flex;
        }

        .explanation-bar .exp-icon {
            font-size: 16px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .explanation-bar .exp-content {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 0;
        }

        .explanation-bar .exp-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-gold);
            margin-bottom: 2px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 5px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .explanation-bar .exp-title .eng {
            font-size: 9px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 400;
        }

        .explanation-bar .exp-text {
            font-family: 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif;
            font-size: 10px;
            line-height: 1.4;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .explanation-bar .exp-tips {
            margin-top: 4px;
            padding: 4px 6px;
            background: rgba(14, 203, 129, 0.15);
            border-left: 2px solid var(--long-green);
            border-radius: 3px;
            font-size: 9px;
            color: var(--long-green);
        }

        .explanation-bar .exp-warning {
            margin-top: 4px;
            padding: 4px 6px;
            background: rgba(246, 70, 93, 0.15);
            border-left: 2px solid var(--short-red);
            border-radius: 3px;
            font-size: 9px;
            color: var(--short-red);
        }

        .explanation-bar .close-exp {
            background: var(--accent-gold);
            border: none;
            color: var(--bg-primary);
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 4px 10px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .explanation-bar .close-exp:hover {
            background: var(--accent-gold-hover);
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .explanation-bar {
                padding: 6px 10px;
                gap: 6px;
            }
            
            .explanation-bar .exp-icon {
                font-size: 14px;
            }
            
            .explanation-bar .exp-title {
                font-size: 10px;
            }
            
            .explanation-bar .exp-text {
                font-size: 9px;
            }
            
            .explanation-bar .exp-tips,
            .explanation-bar .exp-warning {
                font-size: 8px;
                padding: 3px 5px;
            }
        }

        /* 메인 헤더 */
        .main-header {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-secondary) 0%, var(--bg-primary) 100%);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            padding: 0;
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            z-index: 1000;
        }

        /* 설명 바가 열렸을 때 헤더 위치 조정 */
        .explanation-bar.show + .main-header,
        .explanation-bar.show ~ .main-header {
            position: relative;
        }

        /* 모바일에서 헤더 고정 해제 */
        @media (max-width: 1200px) {
            .main-header {
                position: relative !important;
                top: auto !important;
            }
        }

        .header-top {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 12px 20px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .logo-section {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .logo {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 22px;
            font-weight: 800;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-gold) 0%, var(--accent-gold-hover) 50%, #fff 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            text-shadow: var(--glow-gold);
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }

        .logo-sub {
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 500;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .market-mode-tabs {
            display: flex;
            gap: 4px;
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            padding: 4px;
            border-radius: 8px;
        }

        .mode-tab {
            padding: 8px 16px;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 6px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
        }

        .mode-tab:hover {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            background: var(--bg-hover);
        }

        .mode-tab.active {
            color: var(--bg-primary);
            background: var(--accent-gold);
        }

        .mode-tab.futures {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .mode-tab.futures::before {
            content: '⚡';
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        .mode-tab.margin::before {
            content: '📊';
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        .header-right {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 15px;
        }

        .wallet-info {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .wallet-item {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: flex-end;
        }

        .wallet-label {
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .wallet-value {
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-gold);
        }

        .connect-btn {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-gold) 0%, var(--accent-gold-hover) 100%);
            color: var(--bg-primary);
            border: none;
            padding: 10px 24px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .connect-btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: var(--glow-gold);
        }

        /* 심볼 & 가격 바 */
        .price-bar {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 12px 20px;
            gap: 30px;
            overflow-x: auto;
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
        }

        .symbol-selector {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 8px 12px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            transition: background 0.2s;
        }

        .symbol-selector:hover {
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
        }

        .symbol-icon {
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            background: var(--accent-gold);
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .symbol-name {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .symbol-perp {
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            padding: 2px 6px;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        .price-main {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .current-price {
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 28px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .current-price.up {
            color: var(--long-green);
            text-shadow: var(--glow-green);
        }

        .current-price.down {
            color: var(--short-red);
            text-shadow: var(--glow-red);
        }

        .price-change {
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .price-stats {
            display: flex;
            gap: 25px;
        }

        .stat-item {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .stat-label {
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }

        .stat-value {
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        /* 메인 컨테이너 */
        .main-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 280px 1fr 340px;
            gap: 1px;
            background: var(--border-color);
            min-height: auto;
        }

        /* 좌측 패널 - 시장 데이터 */
        .left-panel {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .panel-section {
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .section-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 12px 15px;
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
        }

        .section-title {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .section-title::before {
            content: '';
            width: 3px;
            height: 12px;
            background: var(--accent-gold);
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        .refresh-btn {
            background: none;
            border: none;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 14px;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .refresh-btn:hover {
            color: var(--accent-gold);
            transform: rotate(180deg);
        }

        /* 롱숏 비율 */
        .long-short-ratio {
            padding: 15px;
        }

        .ratio-bar-container {
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        .ratio-labels {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        .ratio-long {
            color: var(--long-green);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .ratio-short {
            color: var(--short-red);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .ratio-bar {
            height: 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
        }

        .ratio-bar-long {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--long-green) 0%, #00ff9d 100%);
            transition: width 0.5s ease;
        }

        .ratio-bar-short {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff6b81 0%, var(--short-red) 100%);
            transition: width 0.5s ease;
        }

        .ratio-details {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .ratio-detail-item {
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            padding: 10px;
            border-radius: 6px;
        }

        .ratio-detail-label {
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .ratio-detail-value {
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* 펀딩비 */
        .funding-section {
            padding: 15px;
        }

        .funding-main {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .funding-rate {
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .funding-rate.positive {
            color: var(--long-green);
        }

        .funding-rate.negative {
            color: var(--short-red);
        }

        .funding-countdown {
            text-align: right;
        }

        .countdown-label {
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .countdown-value {
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 16px;
            color: var(--neon-blue);
        }

        .funding-history {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .funding-history-item {
            flex: 1;
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            padding: 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .funding-history-time {
            font-size: 9px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .funding-history-value {
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* 미결제약정 */
        .open-interest-section {
            padding: 15px;
        }

        .oi-main {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: flex-end;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .oi-value {
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--neon-blue);
        }

        .oi-change {
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
        }

        .oi-chart-container {
            height: 60px;
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 8px;
        }

        /* 청산 데이터 */
        .liquidation-section {
            padding: 15px;
        }

        .liq-stats {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .liq-stat {
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            padding: 12px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .liq-stat.long {
            border-left: 3px solid var(--long-green);
        }

        .liq-stat.short {
            border-left: 3px solid var(--short-red);
        }

        .liq-stat-label {
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .liq-stat-value {
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .liq-feed {
            max-height: 120px;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }

        .liq-item {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 8px 10px;
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            border-radius: 4px;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
            font-size: 11px;
        }

        .liq-item.long-liq {
            border-left: 2px solid var(--short-red);
        }

        .liq-item.short-liq {
            border-left: 2px solid var(--long-green);
        }

        /* 중앙 패널 - 차트 & 분석 */
        .center-panel {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow-y: auto;
            -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
        }

        .chart-controls {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 10px 15px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .timeframe-tabs {
            display: flex;
            gap: 4px;
        }

        .tf-tab {
            padding: 6px 12px;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 4px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .tf-tab:hover {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
        }

        .tf-tab.active {
            color: var(--accent-gold);
            background: rgba(240, 185, 11, 0.1);
        }

        .chart-type-tabs {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .chart-type-btn {
            padding: 6px 12px;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 4px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .chart-type-btn:hover, .chart-type-btn.active {
            color: var(--accent-gold);
            border-color: var(--accent-gold);
        }

        .main-chart-container {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 15px;
            min-height: 350px;
        }

        /* 지표 패널 */
        .indicators-panel {
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .indicator-tabs {
            display: flex;
            padding: 8px 15px;
            gap: 4px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            overflow-x: auto;
        }

        .ind-tab {
            padding: 6px 14px;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 4px;
            cursor: pointer;
            white-space: nowrap;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .ind-tab:hover {
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .ind-tab.active {
            color: var(--bg-primary);
            background: var(--accent-gold);
        }

        .indicator-chart {
            height: 120px;
            padding: 10px 15px;
        }

        /* AI 브리핑 패널 - 업그레이드 */
        .ai-briefing-panel {
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            padding: 15px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(30, 35, 65, 0.9) 0%, var(--bg-secondary) 100%);
        }

        .briefing-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .briefing-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--neon-purple);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .briefing-title::before {
            content: '🤖';
        }

        .briefing-time {
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .briefing-content {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 15px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .briefing-signal {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            padding-bottom: 12px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .signal-badge {
            padding: 8px 16px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .signal-badge.strong-buy {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--long-green) 0%, #00ff9d 100%);
            color: var(--bg-primary);
            border: none;
            box-shadow: var(--glow-green);
        }

        .signal-badge.buy {
            background: var(--long-green-bg);
            color: var(--long-green);
            border: 1px solid var(--long-green);
        }

        .signal-badge.sell {
            background: var(--short-red-bg);
            color: var(--short-red);
            border: 1px solid var(--short-red);
        }

        .signal-badge.strong-sell {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--short-red) 0%, #ff6b81 100%);
            color: white;
            border: none;
            box-shadow: var(--glow-red);
        }

        .signal-badge.hold {
            background: rgba(240, 185, 11, 0.1);
            color: var(--accent-gold);
            border: 1px solid var(--accent-gold);
        }

        .signal-score {
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .briefing-text {
            font-family: 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            line-height: 1.7;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        /* 상세 브리핑 섹션 */
        .briefing-detail-sections {
            display: grid;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-top: 15px;
        }

        .briefing-detail-section {
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 12px;
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-gold);
        }

        .briefing-detail-section.bullish {
            border-left-color: var(--long-green);
        }

        .briefing-detail-section.bearish {
            border-left-color: var(--short-red);
        }

        .briefing-detail-section.neutral {
            border-left-color: var(--neon-blue);
        }

        .detail-section-title {
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .detail-section-content {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .briefing-factors {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 8px;
            margin-top: 12px;
        }

        .factor-item {
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            padding: 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .factor-name {
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .factor-value {
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* 우측 패널 - 호가 & 주문 */
        .right-panel {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        /* 호가창 */
        .orderbook-section {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            min-height: 300px;
        }

        .orderbook-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 10px 15px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .orderbook-tabs {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .ob-tab {
            width: 24px;
            height: 24px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 4px;
            cursor: pointer;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 10px;
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .ob-tab:hover, .ob-tab.active {
            background: var(--accent-gold);
            color: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .orderbook-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            padding: 8px 15px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .orderbook-cols {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            padding: 4px 0;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .orderbook-cols span:nth-child(2) {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .orderbook-cols span:nth-child(3) {
            text-align: right;
        }

        .asks, .bids {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .asks {
            flex-direction: column-reverse;
        }

        .order-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
            padding: 3px 0;
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            position: relative;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: background 0.1s;
        }

        .order-row:hover {
            background: var(--bg-hover);
        }

        .order-row .depth-bar {
            position: absolute;
            right: 0;
            top: 0;
            height: 100%;
            opacity: 0.15;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .order-row.ask .depth-bar {
            background: var(--short-red);
        }

        .order-row.bid .depth-bar {
            background: var(--long-green);
        }

        .order-row .price {
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .order-row.ask .price {
            color: var(--short-red);
        }

        .order-row.bid .price {
            color: var(--long-green);
        }

        .order-row .size {
            text-align: center;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .order-row .total {
            text-align: right;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .spread-row {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            padding: 8px 0;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            margin: 4px 0;
        }

        .spread-price {
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 700;

<script>
        // ============================================
        // 🔶 BINANCE MASTER PRO v3.5
        // 선물 + 마진 통합 트레이딩 시스템
        // © 2025 MINJINE - 서교민, 박선영
        // ============================================

        // 전역 상태 관리
        const AppState = {
            currentSymbol: 'BTCUSDT',
            currentMode: 'futures', // 'futures' or 'margin'
            currentTimeframe: '15m',
            currentIndicator: 'squeeze',
            leverage: 20,
            marginMode: 'cross',
            orderType: 'limit',
            isConnected: true, // 가상 투자 모드는 항상 연결됨
            websocket: null,
            charts: {},
            priceHistory: [],
            indicators: {
                rsi: [],
                macd: [],
                squeeze: []
            }
        };

        // ============================================
        // 💰 가상 투자 시스템 (Virtual Trading System)
        // ============================================
        const VirtualTrading = {
            // 초기 자금 1천만원
            initialBalance: 10000000,
            
            // 현재 잔고
            balance: {
                futures: 10000000,
                margin: 0,
                total: 10000000
            },
            
            // 포지션 목록
            positions: [],
            
            // 미체결 주문
            openOrders: [],
            
            // 거래 내역
            tradeHistory: [],
            
            // 총 수익/손실
            totalPnL: 0,
            totalPnLPercent: 0,
            
            // 승률 통계
            stats: {
                totalTrades: 0,
                winTrades: 0,
                lossTrades: 0,
                winRate: 0,
                maxProfit: 0,
                maxLoss: 0,
                avgProfit: 0
            },
            
            // 현재 가격 저장
            currentPrices: {},
            
            // 포지션 ID 카운터
            positionIdCounter: 1,
            orderIdCounter: 1
        };

        // 로컬 스토리지에서 데이터 불러오기
        function loadVirtualTradingData() {
            const saved = localStorage.getItem('MINJINE_VirtualTrading');
            if (saved) {
                try {
                    const data = JSON.parse(saved);
                    Object.assign(VirtualTrading, data);
                    console.log('📂 가상 투자 데이터 로드 완료');
                } catch (e) {
                    console.log('🆕 새로운 가상 투자 시작');
                }
            }
            updateVirtualBalanceDisplay();
            renderVirtualPositions();
        }

        // 로컬 스토리지에 데이터 저장
        function saveVirtualTradingData() {
            const dataToSave = {
                balance: VirtualTrading.balance,
                positions: VirtualTrading.positions,
                openOrders: VirtualTrading.openOrders,
                tradeHistory: VirtualTrading.tradeHistory,
                totalPnL: VirtualTrading.totalPnL,
                totalPnLPercent: VirtualTrading.totalPnLPercent,
                stats: VirtualTrading.stats,
                positionIdCounter: VirtualTrading.positionIdCounter,
                orderIdCounter: VirtualTrading.orderIdCounter
            };
            localStorage.setItem('MINJINE_VirtualTrading', JSON.stringify(dataToSave));
        }

        // 잔고 표시 업데이트
        function updateVirtualBalanceDisplay() {
            const futuresEl = document.getElementById('futuresBalance');
            const marginEl = document.getElementById('marginBalance');
            const unrealizedEl = document.getElementById('unrealizedPnl');
            const availableEl = document.getElementById('availableBalance');
            
            // 미실현 손익 계산
            let unrealizedPnL = 0;
            VirtualTrading.positions.forEach(pos => {
                const currentPrice = VirtualTrading.currentPrices[pos.symbol] || pos.entryPrice;
                const pnl = calculatePositionPnL(pos, currentPrice);
                unrealizedPnL += pnl;
            });
            
            // 선물 잔고 (마진 사용 중인 금액 제외)
            const usedMargin = VirtualTrading.positions.reduce((sum, pos) => sum + pos.margin, 0);
            const availableBalance = VirtualTrading.balance.futures - usedMargin;
            
            if (futuresEl) futuresEl.textContent = formatKRW(VirtualTrading.balance.futures) + ' KRW';
            if (marginEl) marginEl.textContent = formatKRW(VirtualTrading.balance.margin) + ' KRW';
            if (availableEl) availableEl.textContent = '사용가능: ' + formatKRW(availableBalance) + ' KRW';
            
            if (unrealizedEl) {
                const pnlText = (unrealizedPnL >= 0 ? '+' : '') + formatKRW(unrealizedPnL);
                unrealizedEl.textContent = pnlText;
                unrealizedEl.style.color = unrealizedPnL >= 0 ? 'var(--long-green)' : 'var(--short-red)';
            }
        }

        // 포지션 손익 계산
        function calculatePositionPnL(position, currentPrice) {
            const priceDiff = currentPrice - position.entryPrice;
            const direction = position.side === 'LONG' ? 1 : -1;
            const pnl = direction * priceDiff * position.size;
            return pnl;
        }

        // 포지션 손익률 계산
        function calculatePositionROE(position, currentPrice) {
            const pnl = calculatePositionPnL(position, currentPrice);
            const roe = (pnl / position.margin) * 100;
            return roe;
        }

        // 청산가격 계산
        function calculateLiquidationPrice(position) {
            const maintenanceMarginRate = 0.004; // 0.4%
            const direction = position.side === 'LONG' ? 1 : -1;
            
            if (position.side === 'LONG') {
                // 롱: 진입가 - (마진 * (1 - 유지마진율)) / 수량
                return position.entryPrice - (position.margin * (1 - maintenanceMarginRate)) / position.size;
            } else {
                // 숏: 진입가 + (마진 * (1 - 유지마진율)) / 수량
                return position.entryPrice + (position.margin * (1 - maintenanceMarginRate)) / position.size;
            }
        }

        // 롱 주문 실행
        function executeLongOrder() {
            const priceInput = document.getElementById('orderPrice');
            const sizeInput = document.getElementById('orderSize');
            
            const price = parseFloat(priceInput.value.replace(/,/g, ''));
            const size = parseFloat(sizeInput.value);
            
            if (!price || !size || price <= 0 || size <= 0) {
                showToast('⚠️ 가격과 수량을 입력해주세요', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            const orderValue = price * size;
            const margin = orderValue / AppState.leverage;
            
            // 사용 가능 잔고 확인
            const usedMargin = VirtualTrading.positions.reduce((sum, pos) => sum + pos.margin, 0);
            const availableBalance = VirtualTrading.balance.futures - usedMargin;
            
            if (margin > availableBalance) {
                showToast('❌ 잔고 부족! 필요 마진: ' + formatKRW(margin) + ' KRW', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            // 기존 같은 심볼의 롱 포지션 확인
            const existingPos = VirtualTrading.positions.find(p => 
                p.symbol === AppState.currentSymbol && p.side === 'LONG'
            );
            
            if (existingPos) {
                // 기존 포지션에 추가 (평균 단가 계산)
                const totalSize = existingPos.size + size;
                const totalValue = (existingPos.entryPrice * existingPos.size) + (price * size);
                existingPos.entryPrice = totalValue / totalSize;
                existingPos.size = totalSize;
                existingPos.margin += margin;
                existingPos.leverage = AppState.leverage;
                existingPos.liquidationPrice = calculateLiquidationPrice(existingPos);
                
                showToast(`✅ ${AppState.currentSymbol} 롱 포지션 추가!\n수량: ${totalSize.toFixed(4)}`, 'success');
            } else {
                // 새 포지션 생성
                const newPosition = {
                    id: VirtualTrading.positionIdCounter++,
                    symbol: AppState.currentSymbol,
                    side: 'LONG',
                    size: size,
                    entryPrice: price,
                    currentPrice: price,
                    margin: margin,
                    leverage: AppState.leverage,
                    marginMode: AppState.marginMode,
                    liquidationPrice: 0,
                    unrealizedPnL: 0,
                    roe: 0,
                    openTime: new Date().toISOString()
                };
                newPosition.liquidationPrice = calculateLiquidationPrice(newPosition);
                
                VirtualTrading.positions.push(newPosition);
                showToast(`✅ ${AppState.currentSymbol} 롱 진입!\n가격: ${formatNumber(price)} | 수량: ${size}`, 'success');
            }
            
            // 거래 내역 추가
            VirtualTrading.tradeHistory.unshift({
                id: Date.now(),
                symbol: AppState.currentSymbol,
                side: 'LONG',
                type: 'OPEN',
                price: price,
                size: size,
                value: orderValue,
                fee: orderValue * 0.0004, // 0.04% 수수료
                time: new Date().toISOString()
            });
            
            saveVirtualTradingData();
            updateVirtualBalanceDisplay();
            renderVirtualPositions();
            
            // 입력 초기화
            sizeInput.value = '';
        }

        // 숏 주문 실행
        function executeShortOrder() {
            const priceInput = document.getElementById('orderPrice');
            const sizeInput = document.getElementById('orderSize');
            
            const price = parseFloat(priceInput.value.replace(/,/g, ''));
            const size = parseFloat(sizeInput.value);
            
            if (!price || !size || price <= 0 || size <= 0) {
                showToast('⚠️ 가격과 수량을 입력해주세요', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            const orderValue = price * size;
            const margin = orderValue / AppState.leverage;
            
            const usedMargin = VirtualTrading.positions.reduce((sum, pos) => sum + pos.margin, 0);
            const availableBalance = VirtualTrading.balance.futures - usedMargin;
            
            if (margin > availableBalance) {
                showToast('❌ 잔고 부족! 필요 마진: ' + formatKRW(margin) + ' KRW', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            const existingPos = VirtualTrading.positions.find(p => 
                p.symbol === AppState.currentSymbol && p.side === 'SHORT'
            );
            
            if (existingPos) {
                const totalSize = existingPos.size + size;
                const totalValue = (existingPos.entryPrice * existingPos.size) + (price * size);
                existingPos.entryPrice = totalValue / totalSize;
                existingPos.size = totalSize;
                existingPos.margin += margin;
                existingPos.leverage = AppState.leverage;
                existingPos.liquidationPrice = calculateLiquidationPrice(existingPos);
                
                showToast(`✅ ${AppState.currentSymbol} 숏 포지션 추가!\n수량: ${totalSize.toFixed(4)}`, 'success');
            } else {
                const newPosition = {
                    id: VirtualTrading.positionIdCounter++,
                    symbol: AppState.currentSymbol,
                    side: 'SHORT',
                    size: size,
                    entryPrice: price,
                    currentPrice: price,
                    margin: margin,
                    leverage: AppState.leverage,
                    marginMode: AppState.marginMode,
                    liquidationPrice: 0,
                    unrealizedPnL: 0,
                    roe: 0,
                    openTime: new Date().toISOString()
                };
                newPosition.liquidationPrice = calculateLiquidationPrice(newPosition);
                
                VirtualTrading.positions.push(newPosition);
                showToast(`✅ ${AppState.currentSymbol} 숏 진입!\n가격: ${formatNumber(price)} | 수량: ${size}`, 'success');
            }
            
            VirtualTrading.tradeHistory.unshift({
                id: Date.now(),
                symbol: AppState.currentSymbol,
                side: 'SHORT',
                type: 'OPEN',
                price: price,
                size: size,
                value: orderValue,
                fee: orderValue * 0.0004,
                time: new Date().toISOString()
            });
            
            saveVirtualTradingData();
            updateVirtualBalanceDisplay();
            renderVirtualPositions();
            
            sizeInput.value = '';
        }

        // 포지션 청산
        function closePosition(positionId) {
            const posIndex = VirtualTrading.positions.findIndex(p => p.id === positionId);
            if (posIndex === -1) return;
            
            const position = VirtualTrading.positions[posIndex];
            const currentPrice = VirtualTrading.currentPrices[position.symbol] || position.entryPrice;
            const pnl = calculatePositionPnL(position, currentPrice);
            const fee = (currentPrice * position.size) * 0.0004;
            const netPnl = pnl - fee;
            
            // 잔고 업데이트
            VirtualTrading.balance.futures += position.margin + netPnl;
            VirtualTrading.totalPnL += netPnl;
            VirtualTrading.totalPnLPercent = (VirtualTrading.totalPnL / VirtualTrading.initialBalance) * 100;
            
            // 통계 업데이트
            VirtualTrading.stats.totalTrades++;
            if (netPnl >= 0) {
                VirtualTrading.stats.winTrades++;
                VirtualTrading.stats.maxProfit = Math.max(VirtualTrading.stats.maxProfit, netPnl);
            } else {
                VirtualTrading.stats.lossTrades++;
                VirtualTrading.stats.maxLoss = Math.min(VirtualTrading.stats.maxLoss, netPnl);
            }
            VirtualTrading.stats.winRate = (VirtualTrading.stats.winTrades / VirtualTrading.stats.totalTrades) * 100;
            
            // 거래 내역 추가
            VirtualTrading.tradeHistory.unshift({
                id: Date.now(),
                symbol: position.symbol,
                side: position.side,
                type: 'CLOSE',
                entryPrice: position.entryPrice,
                closePrice: currentPrice,
                size: position.size,
                pnl: netPnl,
                roe: calculatePositionROE(position, currentPrice),
                fee: fee,
                time: new Date().toISOString()
            });
            
            // 포지션 제거
            VirtualTrading.positions.splice(posIndex, 1);
            
            const pnlText = netPnl >= 0 ? `+${formatKRW(netPnl)}` : formatKRW(netPnl);
            const emoji = netPnl >= 0 ? '🎉' : '😢';
            showToast(`${emoji} ${position.symbol} ${position.side} 청산!\n손익: ${pnlText} KRW`, netPnl >= 0 ? 'success' : 'error');
            
            saveVirtualTradingData();
            updateVirtualBalanceDisplay();
            renderVirtualPositions();
        }

        // 포지션 테이블 렌더링
        function renderVirtualPositions() {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('positionsTableBody');
            if (!tbody) return;
            
            // 포지션 카운트 업데이트
            const countEl = document.getElementById('positionCount');
            if (countEl) countEl.textContent = VirtualTrading.positions.length;
            
            if (VirtualTrading.positions.length === 0) {
                tbody.innerHTML = `
                    <tr>
                        <td colspan="10" style="text-align: center; padding: 40px; color: var(--text-muted);">

                            <div style="font-size: 11px; margin-top: 5px;">주문 패널에서 롱/숏 포지션을 열어보세요</div>
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                `;
                return;
            }
            
            let html = '';
            VirtualTrading.positions.forEach(pos => {
                const currentPrice = VirtualTrading.currentPrices[pos.symbol] || pos.entryPrice;
                const pnl = calculatePositionPnL(pos, currentPrice);
                const roe = calculatePositionROE(pos, currentPrice);
                const pnlClass = pnl >= 0 ? 'profit' : 'loss';
                const pnlColor = pnl >= 0 ? 'var(--long-green)' : 'var(--short-red)';
                const sideClass = pos.side === 'LONG' ? 'long' : 'short';
                
                html += `
                    <tr>
                        <td class="pos-symbol">
                            <span style="color: ${pos.side === 'LONG' ? 'var(--long-green)' : 'var(--short-red)'};">●</span>
                            ${pos.symbol}
                        </td>
                        <td><span class="pos-side ${sideClass}">${pos.side}</span></td>
                        <td>${pos.size.toFixed(4)}</td>
                        <td>${formatNumber(pos.entryPrice)}</td>
                        <td>${formatNumber(currentPrice)}</td>
                        <td>${formatNumber(pos.liquidationPrice)}</td>
                        <td>${formatKRW(pos.margin)}</td>
                        <td class="pos-pnl ${pnlClass}">${pnl >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${formatKRW(pnl)}</td>
                        <td style="color: ${pnlColor};">${roe >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${roe.toFixed(2)}%</td>
                        <td>
                            <button class="pos-action-btn close" onclick="closePosition(${pos.id})">청산</button>

            tbody.innerHTML = html;
        }

        // 실시간 포지션 손익 업데이트
        function updatePositionsPnL() {
            VirtualTrading.positions.forEach(pos => {
                const currentPrice = VirtualTrading.currentPrices[pos.symbol] || pos.entryPrice;
                pos.currentPrice = currentPrice;
                pos.unrealizedPnL = calculatePositionPnL(pos, currentPrice);
                pos.roe = calculatePositionROE(pos, currentPrice);
                
                // 청산가 도달 체크
                if (pos.side === 'LONG' && currentPrice <= pos.liquidationPrice) {
                    liquidatePosition(pos.id);
                } else if (pos.side === 'SHORT' && currentPrice >= pos.liquidationPrice) {
                    liquidatePosition(pos.id);
                }
            });
            
            renderVirtualPositions();
            updateVirtualBalanceDisplay();
        }

        // 강제 청산
        function liquidatePosition(positionId) {
            const posIndex = VirtualTrading.positions.findIndex(p => p.id === positionId);
            if (posIndex === -1) return;
            
            const position = VirtualTrading.positions[posIndex];
            
            // 마진 전액 손실
            VirtualTrading.totalPnL -= position.margin;
            VirtualTrading.totalPnLPercent = (VirtualTrading.totalPnL / VirtualTrading.initialBalance) * 100;
            
            VirtualTrading.stats.totalTrades++;
            VirtualTrading.stats.lossTrades++;
            VirtualTrading.stats.maxLoss = Math.min(VirtualTrading.stats.maxLoss, -position.margin);
            VirtualTrading.stats.winRate = (VirtualTrading.stats.winTrades / VirtualTrading.stats.totalTrades) * 100;
            
            VirtualTrading.tradeHistory.unshift({
                id: Date.now(),
                symbol: position.symbol,
                side: position.side,
                type: 'LIQUIDATED',
                entryPrice: position.entryPrice,
                closePrice: position.liquidationPrice,
                size: position.size,
                pnl: -position.margin,
                roe: -100,
                time: new Date().toISOString()
            });
            
            VirtualTrading.positions.splice(posIndex, 1);
            
            showToast(`💥 ${position.symbol} ${position.side} 강제 청산!\n마진 전액 손실: -${formatKRW(position.margin)} KRW`, 'error');
            
            saveVirtualTradingData();
            updateVirtualBalanceDisplay();
            renderVirtualPositions();
        }

        // 잔고 리셋
        function resetVirtualTrading() {
            if (!confirm('⚠️ 정말 가상 투자를 초기화하시겠습니까?\n모든 포지션과 거래 내역이 삭제됩니다.')) {
                return;
            }
            
            VirtualTrading.balance = {
                futures: VirtualTrading.initialBalance,
                margin: 0,
                total: VirtualTrading.initialBalance
            };
            VirtualTrading.positions = [];
            VirtualTrading.openOrders = [];
            VirtualTrading.tradeHistory = [];
            VirtualTrading.totalPnL = 0;
            VirtualTrading.totalPnLPercent = 0;
            VirtualTrading.stats = {
                totalTrades: 0,
                winTrades: 0,
                lossTrades: 0,
                winRate: 0,
                maxProfit: 0,
                maxLoss: 0,
                avgProfit: 0
            };
            VirtualTrading.positionIdCounter = 1;
            VirtualTrading.orderIdCounter = 1;
            
            saveVirtualTradingData();
            updateVirtualBalanceDisplay();
            renderVirtualPositions();
            
            showToast('🔄 가상 투자가 초기화되었습니다!\n시작 자금: 10,000,000 KRW', 'success');
        }

        // 숫자 포맷팅 (원화)

            return Math.round(num).toLocaleString('ko-KR');
        }

        function formatNumber(num) {
            if (num >= 1000) {
                return num.toLocaleString('ko-KR', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
            }
            return num.toFixed(4);
        }

        // CORS 프록시 (필요시 사용)
        const CORS_PROXY = 'https://api.allorigins.win/raw?url=';

        // 바이낸스 선물 API
        const BINANCE_FUTURES_API = 'https://fapi.binance.com';
        const BINANCE_SPOT_API = 'https://api.binance.com';

        // API 호출 래퍼
        async function fetchBinanceAPI(endpoint, useFutures = true) {
            const baseUrl = useFutures ? BINANCE_FUTURES_API : BINANCE_SPOT_API;
            try {
                const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}${endpoint}`);
                if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
                return await response.json();
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('API 호출 실패:', error);
                // 프록시로 재시도
                try {
                    const proxyResponse = await fetch(`${CORS_PROXY}${encodeURIComponent(baseUrl + endpoint)}`);
                    return await proxyResponse.json();
                } catch (proxyError) {
                    console.error('프록시 호출도 실패:', proxyError);
                    return null;
                }
            }
        }

        function updateFundingCountdown(nextFundingTime) {
            const update = () => {
                const now = Date.now();
                const diff = nextFundingTime - now;
                
                if (diff <= 0) {
                    document.getElementById('fundingCountdown').textContent = '정산 중...';
                    return;
                }
                
                const hours = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                const minutes = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                const seconds = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                
                document.getElementById('fundingCountdown').textContent = 
                    `${String(hours).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(seconds).padStart(2, '0')}`;
            };
            
            update();
            setInterval(update, 1000);
        }

        // ============================================
        // 기술적 지표 계산
        // ============================================

        function calculateIndicators() {
            const closes = AppState.priceHistory.map(k => k.close);
            
            // RSI 계산 (14기간)
            AppState.indicators.rsi = calculateRSI(closes, 14);
            
            // MACD 계산
            AppState.indicators.macd = calculateMACD(closes);
            
            // 스퀴즈 모멘텀 계산
            AppState.indicators.squeeze = calculateSqueezeMomentum(AppState.priceHistory);
        }

        function calculateRSI(closes, period = 14) {
            const rsi = [];
            let gains = 0;
            let losses = 0;
            
            for (let i = 1; i < closes.length; i++) {
                const change = closes[i] - closes[i - 1];
                
                if (i <= period) {
                    if (change >= 0) gains += change;
                    else losses -= change;
                    
                    if (i === period) {
                        const avgGain = gains / period;
                        const avgLoss = losses / period;
                        const rs = avgLoss === 0 ? 100 : avgGain / avgLoss;
                        rsi.push(100 - (100 / (1 + rs)));
                    } else {
                        rsi.push(50);
                    }
                } else {
                    const prevGain = gains / period;
                    const prevLoss = losses / period;
                    
                    if (change >= 0) {
                        gains = (prevGain * (period - 1) + change);
                        losses = (prevLoss * (period - 1));
                    } else {
                        gains = (prevGain * (period - 1));
                        losses = (prevLoss * (period - 1) - change);
                    }
                    
                    const avgGain = gains / period;
                    const avgLoss = losses / period;
                    const rs = avgLoss === 0 ? 100 : avgGain / avgLoss;
                    rsi.push(100 - (100 / (1 + rs)));
                }
            }
            
            return rsi;
        }

        function calculateMACD(closes, fastPeriod = 12, slowPeriod = 26, signalPeriod = 9) {
            const emaFast = calculateEMA(closes, fastPeriod);
            const emaSlow = calculateEMA(closes, slowPeriod);
            
            const macdLine = emaFast.map((v, i) => v - emaSlow[i]);
            const signalLine = calculateEMA(macdLine, signalPeriod);
            const histogram = macdLine.map((v, i) => v - signalLine[i]);
            
            return { macdLine, signalLine, histogram };
        }

        function calculateEMA(data, period) {
            const ema = [];
            const multiplier = 2 / (period + 1);
            
            // 첫 번째 EMA는 SMA
            let sum = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < period && i < data.length; i++) {
                sum += data[i];
            }
            ema[period - 1] = sum / period;
            
            // 이후 EMA 계산
            for (let i = period; i < data.length; i++) {
                ema[i] = (data[i] - ema[i - 1]) * multiplier + ema[i - 1];
            }
            
            // 앞부분 채우기
            for (let i = 0; i < period - 1; i++) {
                ema[i] = ema[period - 1];
            }
            
            return ema;
        }

        function calculateSqueezeMomentum(klines, length = 20, multBB = 2.0, multKC = 1.5) {
            const closes = klines.map(k => k.close);
            const highs = klines.map(k => k.high);
            const lows = klines.map(k => k.low);
            
            const result = [];
            
            for (let i = length; i < closes.length; i++) {
                const slice = closes.slice(i - length, i);
                const highSlice = highs.slice(i - length, i);
                const lowSlice = lows.slice(i - length, i);
                
                // 볼린저 밴드
                const sma = slice.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / length;
                const stdDev = Math.sqrt(slice.map(x => Math.pow(x - sma, 2)).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / length);
                const upperBB = sma + multBB * stdDev;
                const lowerBB = sma - multBB * stdDev;
                
                // 켈트너 채널
                const tr = highSlice.map((h, j) => {
                    const prevClose = j > 0 ? slice[j - 1] : slice[j];
                    return Math.max(h - lowSlice[j], Math.abs(h - prevClose), Math.abs(lowSlice[j] - prevClose));
                });
                const atr = tr.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / length;
                const upperKC = sma + multKC * atr;
                const lowerKC = sma - multKC * atr;
                
                // 스퀴즈 상태
                const sqzOn = lowerBB > lowerKC && upperBB < upperKC;
                
                // 모멘텀 값 (선형 회귀 기반 간소화)
                const highestHigh = Math.max(...highSlice);
                const lowestLow = Math.min(...lowSlice);
                const midpoint = (highestHigh + lowestLow) / 2;
                const momentum = closes[i] - (midpoint + sma) / 2;
                
                result.push({
                    value: momentum,
                    sqzOn: sqzOn,
                    color: momentum > 0 ? 
                        (momentum > (result[result.length - 1]?.value || 0) ? '#00ff88' : '#008844') :
                        (momentum < (result[result.length - 1]?.value || 0) ? '#ff4444' : '#882222')
                });
            }
            
            return result;
        }

        function updateIndicatorChart() {
            if (!AppState.charts.indicator) return;

            const chart = AppState.charts.indicator;
            
            if (indicator === 'squeeze' && AppState.indicators.squeeze.length) {

                chart.data.datasets[0].data = AppState.indicators.rsi;
                chart.data.datasets[0].backgroundColor = 'rgba(176, 77, 255, 0.2)';
                chart.data.datasets[0].borderColor = '#b84dff';
                chart.data.datasets[0].label = 'RSI';

                chart.config.type = 'bar';
                const hist = AppState.indicators.macd.histogram;
                chart.data.labels = hist.map((_, i) => i);
                chart.data.datasets[0].data = hist;
                chart.data.datasets[0].backgroundColor = hist.map(v => v >= 0 ? '#0ecb81' : '#f6465d');

        // AI 브리핑 생성
